brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces mounting scrutiny over what intelligence he possessed before Hamas's October 7 attack, as the question threatens to reshape Israel's electoral landscape. The controversy centers on whether security failures preceded the assault that killed over 1,200 people and triggered Israel's subsequent military campaign in Gaza.

Netanyahu's political survival increasingly depends on his ability to frame the narrative around the attack and his government's handling of it, Al Jazeera English reported. The dispute over pre-attack intelligence has become central to election dynamics, with critics questioning the government's preparedness and response.
dek: What did Netanyahu know about October 7 before it happened?
title: Netanyahu battles to control election narrative over October 7 intelligence
